findings.detail: The graph denoising formula is implemented as specified (directed train transitions, symmetrized weights, out-degree correction, normalized neighbor consensus), but the prescribed lambda set {0.1, 0.3, 0.5} and validation-only selection protocol are not implemented. The trainer unconditionally uses 0.1, and its own comment delegates selection downstream without emitting the other candidate tokenizers.
findings.reproduction: Run the entry point with the checked-in constants: denoise_with_train_transitions is called once at line 296 with GRAPH_LAMBDA=0.1; no code path computes 0.3 or 0.5 or produces validation-selected outputs.
findings.correction: Provide a controlled candidate-lambda run/export path for all three specified values, preserving identical training configuration, and select/report the chosen candidate only under the predeclared validation protocol. If this tree intentionally represents only one candidate, explicitly scope it as such and ensure a coordinating experiment produces the other candidates.
